primary_metric: conditional held-out mean negative log probability in nats per retained token
reference_measure: counting measure on the fixed training-selected word types
tokenizer: NFC original sentence text; Unicode letter runs with internal straight/curly apostrophes; lowercase; curly apostrophe to straight; retain ASCII-letter words and internal apostrophes
phonemes: number of symbols in the unnumbered canonical CMUdict entry; no acoustic or sonority interpretation
duplicate_rule: exclude test sentences whose exact original text occurs anywhere in the official training file; retain exclusion ledger
exposure_status: Retrospective familiar public corpus; no external preregistration. Test file decoded only after protocol, algorithm and training fit freeze.
